messages:
amanda: Quick sync — final SEO pass for Q2 launch. Need one doc with: 1) primary/secondary keywords per page, 2) JSON-LD schema for product + FAQ, 3) internal linking plan for blog & docs (top 10 anchors), 4) 301 redirects for legacy /inference pages, 5) webinar landing UTM + canonical strategy. Owners + ETA? cc @sara-m @jonah @leo @priya

sara-m: I can own keywords + internal link map. What format preferred? CSV or Google Sheet?

jonah: CSV works. Add a column for intent (informational / commercial). I'll draft schema examples after I see the final product copy. FAQ schema should be short Q/A only.

leo: On redirects — we have ~7 legacy slugs from last year that must 301 -> new launch pages. I can open a redirect PR in infra tomorrow but need the approved slug mapping first.

amanda: Awesome. Sara — can you drop initial keyword list by EOD Wed? Jonah — can you draft sample JSON-LD for the product page by Thu? @leo — PR by Fri. Priya — can you confirm webinar landing canonical/UTM handling? @priya

priya: Got it. Proposed UTMs: utm_source=blog, utm_medium=webinar-cta, utm_campaign=q2-launch. Landing page should canonicalize to itself; blog CTAs use tracking params but canonical -> product launch main page. I'll write a short doc with examples.

jonah: Draft JSON-LD for product (will refine):
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Product",
  "name": "Redwood Inference",
  "description": "High-performance LLM inference platform for hosted, dedicated, and private deployments.",
  "brand": {"@type": "Organization", "name": "Redwood"}
}
```

sara-m: I'll include keyword intent and a ‘mapping to page’ column. Also adding internal anchor suggestions: 'inference costs', 'low-latency LLM serving', 'private deployment', 'dedicated GPU pools', 'model routing' — aiming for top 8-10 anchors per pillar.

amanda: Perfect. One more ask: QA — let's run Screaming Frog after redirects are in place and share before/after crawls. Leo, can you add me to the PR for review?

leo: Yep — adding you now. I'll paste the redirect mapping here once PR is open and tag reviewers.

seo-bot: Reminder: scheduled site crawl tonight at 02:00 UTC. Will flag new 404s and redirect chains.

amanda: Thanks — team, we'll consolidate into /marketing/seo-launch-q2 doc after items complete. :party_parrot:
